Conn. State Agencies § 14-137-64a(c) lets the commissioner revoke the card once its holder is 'no longer entitled to be present', and sets no term; CGS chapter 246 has no such provision (searched for 'authorized stay', 'lawful status', 'immigration status', 'visa', 'legal presence', 'citizen'). SLATE keeps the term to the end of lawful presence as its assumption, said so in systems/identity.ts and on the guide's line ('SLATE's reading where the state publishes none').
